<svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" viewBox="0 0 640 360" font-family="'Arial Black',sans-serif">
  <defs>
    <linearGradient id="sg-dirty" x1="0" y1="0" x2="1" y2="0">
      <stop offset="0" stop-color="#6b3f2e"/>
      <stop offset="1" stop-color="#8a1f1f"/>
    </linearGradient>
    <linearGradient id="sg-clean" x1="0" y1="0" x2="1" y2="0">
      <stop offset="0" stop-color="#dff1ff"/>
      <stop offset="1" stop-color="#ffffff"/>
    </linearGradient>
    <clipPath id="sg-wipe">
      <rect x="0" y="0" width="0" height="360">
        <animate attributeName="width" values="0;640;640;0" keyTimes="0;0.45;0.8;1" dur="4s" repeatCount="indefinite"/>
      </rect>
    </clipPath>
    <style>
      .sg-bolt{animation:sgflash 1s steps(2,end) infinite}
      @keyframes sgflash{0%,100%{opacity:1}50%{opacity:0.55}}
    </style>
  </defs>

  <rect width="640" height="360" fill="url(#sg-dirty)"/>
  <g fill="#3a1a10" opacity="0.5">
    <circle cx="90" cy="70" r="30"/><circle cx="500" cy="290" r="46"/><circle cx="560" cy="80" r="22"/>
    <circle cx="150" cy="300" r="18"/><circle cx="380" cy="60" r="16"/>
  </g>

  <rect width="640" height="360" fill="url(#sg-clean)" clip-path="url(#sg-wipe)"/>
  <g clip-path="url(#sg-wipe)" font-family="'Arial Black',sans-serif">
    <text x="320" y="180" text-anchor="middle" font-size="30" fill="#0a5aa8">SPOTLESS.*</text>
  </g>

  <!-- the wipe edge -->
  <rect width="4" height="360" fill="#ffe14d">
    <animate attributeName="x" values="0;640;640;0" keyTimes="0;0.45;0.8;1" dur="4s" repeatCount="indefinite"/>
  </rect>

  <g transform="translate(320 60)" text-anchor="middle">
    <text font-size="48" fill="#ffe14d" stroke="#7a4a00" stroke-width="1.5" class="sg-bolt">SCRUBGOD 9000</text>
  </g>
  <text x="320" y="340" text-anchor="middle" font-size="13" fill="#ffe6cf">*Stains not removed. Merely relocated to a molecular level you can't see.</text>
</svg>
description: Title card for the ScrubGod 9000 infomercial.
name: ScrubGod 9000 — Logo
